decisions.statement: The identity of a credential is the account uuid the profile probe answers.
A profile probe is given 750 milliseconds to answer.
A probe answered with anything but success throws saying the status and a summary of the body.
A body summarized is collapsed onto one line and cut at 200 characters.
A profile body the profile shape refuses throws.
A profile naming no email reads as an identity with no email.
A credential belonging to an upstream account another model-account is pinned to is refused.
A model-account pinned to no upstream account takes the account that model-account resolves to.
A credential resolving to the upstream account already pinned is a match.
A credential resolving to another upstream account is refused unless the caller allows a rebind.
A rebind names the upstream account moved off as well as the account moved to.
The keys a rebind clears are the keys one upstream account's readings fill.
A pin moving a page off an upstream account clears those keys and drops every value beside the page.
A pin writes its credential through the credential push.
A push refused or finding no page refuses the pin.
A push answered as stale still pins.
A page stating an upstream account other than the account handed in refuses the pin.
A refusal names the stage the pin stopped at.
Writing a pin answers with an outcome rather than throwing.
The repository root reaches this module as a parameter.
The reading of the index and the reader of page bodies reach this module as parameters.
The doors the credential push opens reach this module as a parameter.
Nothing here writes the uuid a page is pinned to.
Deciding a pin reads no page and no clock and no network.
Nothing here logs.
A page stating no upstream account refuses every pin.
A pin that clears the previous account's readings and then fails leaves those readings cleared.
A rebind drops the values beside the page that belong to no upstream account.

definition: which upstream account a credential belongs to, and pinning a page to it
